visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People: Face/Hands] A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a grey hoodie, holds an iPhone in her left hand. She has a distressed facial expression with slightly open lips. [Objects: Details/State] The iPhone screen displays a cluttered list of plain text URLs within the Notes application. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with a television and shelves visible in the background. (2) [People: Face/Hands] The character's thumb is shown tapping the screen of an iPhone. [Objects: Details/State] The screen transition shows the Notes app interface changing from plain text links to visual rich previews with images of restaurants and Google Maps icons. [Setting: Background/Lighting] Close-up shot with shallow depth of field, focusing on the device. (3) [People: Face/Hands] The woman's hands are shown navigating the iOS share sheet on the phone screen. [Objects: Details/State] She selects the 'Notes' app icon. The screen displays an Instagram Reels information page. [Setting: Background/Lighting] Sharp, bright studio-like lighting highlighting the screen's digital interface. (4) [People: Face/Hands] The main character reappears in the frame, holding the phone and pointing at it while smiling. [Objects: Details/State] A large grey otter-shaped plush toy enters the frame and stands next to her. The phone screen shows a video preview from Instagram embedded in a note. (5) [People: Face/Hands] The woman looks at the otter toy with a playful, annoyed expression and pushes it away. [Objects: Details/State] The camera cuts to a monochrome shot of the otter plush toy lying flat on its back on a grey tiled floor. [Setting: Background/Lighting] High-contrast black and white filter applied to the final scene.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 不要再存一堆文字網址了. [Slogan]: iPhone 備忘錄網址預覽. (2) [Subtitle]: 查找資訊超方便. (3) [Subtitle]: 使用方式超簡單. (4) [Subtitle]: 網頁、地圖或者社群影片直接按分享. (5) [Subtitle]: 選擇存成備忘錄. (6) [Subtitle]: 覺得預覽太大還可以長按選擇. (7) [Subtitle]: 顯示為小. (8) [Subtitle]: 遇到沒辦法直接存成預覽的. (9) [Subtitle]: 只要長按網址往下選擇顯示連結預覽. (10) [Subtitle]: 就可以囉. (11) [Subtitle]: 用來編輯旅遊行程或者做筆記都一目了然. (12) [Subtitle]: 這麼好用的方法還不趕快學起來. (13) [Subtitle]: 你學這些餐廳是要跟我去吃喔. (14) [Subtitle]: 走開啦. (15) [Variety]: 獺生真難.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Optimization Tips -> Outcome -> Comedic Tag
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a concise tech tutorial aimed at iPhone users, teaching them how to transform plain text URLs in the Notes app into visually rich previews for better organization and navigation. It uses a high-energy delivery and a comedic ending with a mascot to engage the audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While it features Apple and Instagram, it functions as a software tip rather than a sponsored advertisement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social-media-native editing with a strong focus on utility and humor. The use of a mascot adds a distinctive brand personality.
